conclusions: All sixteen live Super calls delivered complete JSON with known logical and physical usage; no provider failure, retry, truncation, JSON syntax rejection or local delivery block was observed.

Both arms attempted four cases and accepted zero. The control executed seven mathematically incorrect proposals and had one native-IR rejection. Treatment executed five mathematically incorrect proposals and had three native-IR rejections.

All sixteen proposals met the public objective-output label set, and no output-contract or certificate-schema rejection occurred. This is observed supporting interface reliability under a common contract, not a causal comparison against the preceding different corpus or a cognitive gain.

Seven unique arm/task stages reached independent mathematical grading and were wrong. One treatment interpolation stage was IR-only and ungraded. Five first proposals and seven second proposals were mathematically graded; none were correct.

Only the two treatment network second calls actually received an admitted candidate; both remained mathematically wrong. Treatment interpolation first proposals failed IR admission and therefore could not supply admitted context. The context hypothesis has no demonstrated repair benefit in this epoch.

Native IR findings were two SOURCE_NOT_BOUND and two OUTPUT_BINDING rejections; none were authority denials. Their rejected mathematics remains ungraded. Count evidence does not reconstruct or repair the original model programs.

Control used 38349 reported tokens versus 37250 treatment with eight logical and eight physical calls per arm. No pair met the five-percent realized-token matching tolerance; only two pairs used no more treatment compute.

Independent first proposals were not shared starts. Four new values in two known formal families, limited context exposure and unmatched realized compute limit causal/generalization claims. No default, authority, cognition, benchmark-score, procedure transfer or recursion promotion is supported.
diagnosis.nextGeneralCorrection: Retire the claim that this retained-context option has shown a repair benefit. Before another mechanism, isolate whether the same live model can produce correct direct quantitative certificates without the native-IR interface under a fresh fixed-budget ablation; use the identical external oracle and output contract, charge all calls/tokens, and preserve first/repaired outcomes. This is a proposed diagnostic, not a launched campaign or permission for broader execution.
